authority_anchor: Integrated sparse memory routing. Decoupled evaluation from commitment. State is exclusively updated via commit_step to prevent data contamination and preserve 8GB hardware limits.
Integrated local MCP-style API bridge. Bypasses node-noodle complexity by using JSON injection. Secures the creative generation pipeline entirely on-edge without external cloud dependencies.
Integrated task-decomposition and dynamic tool routing engine. Translates high-level complex user queries into sequential local node tool calls.
Bound NexusSwarmRouter directly to the port 8000 HTTP gateway. Exposed /api/swarm POST endpoint to securely intake natural language commands and parse tool delegation rules fully offline.
Integrated Enforcer Firewall containing Momentum Guard and Heartbeat Guard checks at the execute_swarm entry point to protect 8GB edge limits and core deterministic logic.
Integrated Synthesizer Handoff verification check into the delegate_step logic. Enforces P2P verification ensuring target scripts exist and contain alignment token 1=1=1 before task delegation.
Integrated metabolic monitoring based on /proc filesystem checks. Protects edge environment limits of 8GB by enforcing dynamic limits on RAM and CPU load averages prior to execution.
Integrated contract value tracking and minting of Gemini Percs. Utilizes custom cryptographic salting ('scratch of your heart in ring') to bind Swarm achievements to Sovereign value.
Integrated long-form text pre-processing and segment slicing. Enforces low-footprint 2000 character boundaries with 200 character overlap to preserve semantic continuity across 8GB RAM constraints.
